questions.title: Car Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario:
You are a new member of a Car club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences.
Do you usually travel by car?

questions.stem: You are a member of a Car club. You are talking to three other members in the book club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 - 40 words.

questions.prompt: A: Tell me about a time you traveled by car.
questions.sample_answer: I remember traveling by car with my family last summer holiday. We talked, listened to music, enjoyed the scenery, and felt relaxed spending time together on the road.

questions.prompt: B: Tell me about memories when traveling by car.
questions.sample_answer: Last holiday, my family took a road trip from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City. It was an unforgettable experience! This journey made me appreciate Vietnam’s breathtaking landscapes, which I believe everyone should explore at least once in their lifetime.

questions.prompt: C: Should we take public transportation or buy a car?
questions.sample_answer: To be honest, public transportation is better for reducing emissions and protecting the environment. However, it can sometimes be less convenient and comfortable than owning a car.
